en-us.Mall_Foodcourt_Begin_initial: The food court smells of hot rice and soup. Set meals are ready at the counter; there is time to find a table and enjoy a leisurely meal.
en-us.Mall_Foodcourt_Begin_join: $joining.name$ enters the food court, looking past the pickup counter for a place to sit. Steam rises from the meals amid the hum of conversation.
en-us.Mall_Foodcourt_Begin_late: $joining.name$ reaches the food court a little late. The pickup counter is still lit, with enough time to sit down and enjoy a proper meal.
